name: shfmt
description: Shell script formatter supporting POSIX sh, Bash, and mksh with customizable styles

shfmt.description: Format and pretty-print shell scripts with consistent style and indentation
shfmt.usage:
shfmt script.sh
shfmt -w *.sh
shfmt -i 4 script.sh
shfmt -d script.sh
shfmt -ln bash script.sh
